summary: #edu407 I would say blogging is a different genre and it doesn't need to be in a conversational tone unless that is what you want your blog to be. Blogging for class is slightly artifical as it comes with an audience of consequence (me) but write for you and never an audience.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#edu407 I would say blogging is a different genre and it doesn't need to be in a conversational tone unless that is what you want your blog to be.

Blogging for class is slightly artifical as it comes with an audience of consequence (me) but write for you and never an audience.
